context: Tests whether plugin-creator builds a valid cross-agent hook artifact for deterministic, agent-independent PostToolUse behavior. The output must use the generic hooks tier, the supported matcher and command shape, a bundled entrypoint anchored through TESSL_PLUGIN_DIR, and must leave agent-native configuration to Tessl.

checklist.name: Generic PostToolUse hook declared
checklist.description: validate-after-edit/.tessl-plugin/plugin.json contains a top-level `hooks` field with a `PostToolUse` hook group

checklist.name: Edit and Write matcher
checklist.description: The PostToolUse hook group has a matcher that covers both Edit and Write tool calls, such as `Edit|Write`

checklist.name: Valid command hook shape
checklist.description: The group contains a command hook with `type: command`; if `args` is present the command is an executable and args are separate, otherwise the command is a valid shell command string

checklist.name: Plugin path anchored correctly
checklist.description: The hook declaration references its bundled entrypoint with the exact braced `${TESSL_PLUGIN_DIR}` token in command or args; it does not rely on a bare relative plugin path

checklist.name: Hook entrypoint ships
checklist.description: A substantive hook entrypoint exists under validate-after-edit/hooks/ and runs `npm run validate:changed`; the manifest reference resolves to that file

checklist.name: Generic tier preferred
checklist.description: The manifest does not use `nativeHooks` for this agent-independent requirement

checklist.name: No prose-only substitute
checklist.description: The output does not substitute a skill or rule that only tells the model to run validation instead of implementing the deterministic hook

checklist.name: No direct agent config edits
checklist.description: The output does not create or edit agent-native hook configuration such as .claude/settings.json or .cursor/hooks.json

checklist.name: Valid plugin metadata
checklist.description: validate-after-edit/.tessl-plugin/plugin.json has the requested name plus valid version and description fields
